skill.name: raffle-winner-picker
skill.description: Picks random winners from lists, spreadsheets, or Google Sheets for giveaways, raffles, and contests. Ensures fair, unbiased selection with transparency.
skill.summary: Selects raffle winners and runner-ups from common list formats with clear selection records.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Manual drawings can create doubt, duplicate winners, and weak records. This skill selects winners from common data sources and reports the method clearly.
actual_capabilities: Selects one or multiple winners from plain lists, CSV files, Excel files, or Google Sheets.
Prevents duplicate winners and applies named exclusion lists.
Supports weighted drawings based on an entry-count column.
Chooses ranked runner-ups and divides participant lists into random teams.
Reports selected rows, participant details, the selection method, and a timestamp.
limitations: Requires readable source data and any necessary Google Sheets permissions.
Does not independently verify participant identity, eligibility, or contest compliance.
Seeded drawings are reproducible but predictable, so their use must be documented.
Does not provide a certified external audit of the drawing.

use_cases.title: Run a Subscriber Giveaway
use_cases.description: Select a winner and backups from newsletter or social media entries while excluding previous winners.

use_cases.title: Draw Event Prizes
use_cases.description: Choose several unique attendees from a CSV or spreadsheet and retain a clear result record.

use_cases.title: Assign Limited Places
use_cases.description: Randomly allocate research places, beta access, or team membership when demand exceeds capacity.

prompt_templates.title: Pick One Winner
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick one random winner from this list: {participants}. Show the selected name, list position, method, and timestamp.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has a short participant list.

prompt_templates.title: Select Multiple Winners
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick {winner_count} unique winners from {file}. Exclude {excluded_names} and show each selected row.
prompt_templates.scenario: A drawing uses a CSV or Excel file.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Winner and Runner-Ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Select one winner and {runner_up_count} ranked runner-ups from {sheet_url}. Ignore duplicate entries and record the method and timestamp.
prompt_templates.scenario: A giveaway needs backups and an audit record.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Weighted Reproducible Draw
prompt_templates.prompt: From {file}, select one winner and three ranked runner-ups using {weight_column}. Exclude {names}, use seed {seed}, and show verification details.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced drawing uses ticket weights and independent verification.

output_examples.input: Pick one winner from a list of 75 eligible subscribers.
output_examples.output: Winner: Priya Shah, list position 18 of 75. Method: secure random selection. Selected at 2026-07-23 14:00 UTC.

output_examples.input: Pick two unique winners and one runner-up from attendees.csv.
output_examples.output: Winners: Mateo Ruiz, row 24; Lin Chen, row 81. Runner-up: Amina Yusuf, row 43. Duplicate winners were excluded.

output_examples.input: Split 20 participants into four random teams.
output_examples.output: Four teams were created with five participants each. Every participant appears once, and the assignments are ready for review.

best_practices: Remove ineligible and duplicate entries before the drawing.
Record the source, selection method, exclusions, and timestamp.
Limit shared participant data to the fields required for selection and verification.
anti_patterns: Do not publish private contact details with winner announcements.
Do not change eligibility rules or weights after viewing results.
Do not claim independent verification when only the generated result was reviewed.

faq.question: Can this skill use Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an accessible sheet URL and identify the worksheet or columns to use.

faq.question: Can it prevent duplicate winners?
faq.answer: Yes. Request unique winners and provide previous winners or other exclusions.

faq.question: Does it use secure randomness?
faq.answer: The skill directs the agent to use cryptographically secure randomness. Confirm the chosen tool and recorded method for important drawings.

faq.question: Can a drawing be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes, when a seed is used and recorded. A seeded drawing is predictable and differs from an unseeded secure drawing.

faq.question: Does it verify winner eligibility?
faq.answer: No. Review identities, contest rules, required actions, and geographic restrictions before announcing a winner.

faq.question: How should participant privacy be protected?
faq.answer: Share only required columns, restrict source access, and remove private details from public results.
